draftsStartedNew: Set aside — you're on a fresh draft
draftsNoVersions: Versions appear as you keep writing
draftsSwitched: Switched drafts — the other one is set aside
draftRestored: Picked up where you left off
draftFilesNotKept: Attached files aren't kept in drafts — add them again if you need them.
offerBody: From {time}. Restore them, or keep the saved version?
offerRemoteBody: A newer version of this draft was saved elsewhere {time}. Load it, or keep what's here?
readinessMissingBody: Tap a highlighted item to jump to it.
readinessReadyBody: Everything required is there. Dashed items are optional.
